sources.label: New mask, same task.
sources.author: Doom
patch_list: Disables all Cloudflare telemetry by no-oping the analytics bundle builder and the Firebase event dispatchers.
Bypasses OkHttp certificate pinning on Cloudflare API calls to allow TLS traffic inspection.
Forces WarpPlusState to UNLIMITED on every AccountData instance by intercepting the primary constructor before the account type field is written.
